# YSF VW and V/D mode 1 channel vectors (docs/spec/ysf.md 3.5), read by tests/host/ysfTest.c. Made once on a host with
# MMDVMHost's own code (CAMBEFEC::regenerateIMBE and regenerateYSFDN, CYSFConvolution, CYSFPayload; MMDVMHost
# c145bc8, GPL-2.0-or-later), which is neither linked nor shipped. Its regeneration is a decode and a re-encode, so each
# "out" is a valid field as MMDVMHost writes it.
# Only correctable fields are used: regenerateIMBE writes 24 bits back for each 23-bit Golay word, which clears the
# first bit of c1-c4 before it decodes them, so on a field past the codes' reach it differs from a correct decoder.
#
# vw <VCH in, 18 bytes> <VCH out> <bits MMDVMHost corrected>     a valid field with 0-3 bit errors
# vd1 <VCH in, 9 bytes> <VCH out> <bits corrected>                a valid field with 0-3 bit errors
# vwsub <DCH content, 20 bytes> <DCH on air, 45 bytes>            the sub-header's DCH; MMDVMHost's decoder accepts it
